milestone: Qdrant-source distribution-based score fusion quality screen
mechanism: Per lane Welford sample variance; normalize by mean +/-3 sample standard deviations; empty lane empty; single or constant lane 0.5; sum scores of shared chunk IDs; equal lane weights 1. No clipping, no weight or sigma sweep.
adaptations: Python float64 arithmetic rather than Rust f32; deterministic fusion ties use chunk_id ascending. Neural rerank ties use fusion score descending then chunk_id ascending as existing production.
screen_policy: All 809 official SciFact train queries. Reuse every actual full-union BGE cross-encoder score once for quality-only candidate replay. Strictly require all dense/sparse union IDs scored and source mappings consistent. No cached latency claim; changed batch packing can require a later actual run.
primary: One nDCG@10 comparison; 10000 paired bootstrap over shared-positive-document connected components, 95% interval
secondary: Exploratory Recall@5/20 and MRR@10; fusion candidate source-document coverage
decision: Only a passing screen qualifies for real paired retrieval and latency evaluation; otherwise preserve baseline and close this mechanism without parameter tuning
limits: Repeated DEV labels and reuse of earlier measured candidate scores make this exploratory screening, not independent confirmation or a platform Formal Experiment. No generated-answer claim, no test or NFCorpus label access, no production default change.

_publication.policy: case text, source corpus, requests, credentials and per-case objects omitted
